summary: Document bounded autonomous operation and interface bootstrap in the guide

delivery.outcome: A supervisor reading the guide can run bounded autonomous work end to end: check readiness, verify contract bounds, choose the right flag, bootstrap the Shell and treat the endpoint catalog as partial.
nonGoals: Change any machine-checkable contract, schema or profile
Describe an interface surface that was not observed on a live deployment
Copy a deployment address or port as a durable contract
Repair the runtime defects owned by subactor/platform

architecture.decision: Extend the narrative guide with the fifth authority level, a readiness preflight step in the supervisor loop, an accurate Shell bootstrap and an explicit warning that endpoint discovery is partial.
architecture.rollback: Revert the guide sections to release 0.4.0 prose; the executable contracts delivered by ticket-011 remain valid on their own.

validation.evidence: manifest version and VERSION agree with the documented release
